title: Measurable selection of a near-maximizing unit covector field
statement: Let μ be a measure on ℝ^P, ξ : ℝ^P → MultiVector P n be μ-a.e. strongly measurable, η > 0, and assume that for μ-a.e. x there is an n-covector β with |β|_E ≤ 1 and ξ(x)(β) = 1. Then there is a strongly measurable g : ℝ^P → Covector (Euclid P) n with |g(x)|_E ≤ 1 for every x and 1 − η ≤ ξ(x)(g(x)) for μ-a.e. x.
lean_statement: ∀ (P n : ℕ) (μ : Measure (Euclid P)) (ξ : Euclid P → MultiVector P n) (η : ℝ), 0 < η → AEStronglyMeasurable ξ μ → (∀ᵐ x ∂μ, ∃ β : Covector (Euclid P) n, covectorEuclideanNorm β ≤ 1 ∧ ξ x β = 1) → ∃ g : Euclid P → Covector (Euclid P) n, StronglyMeasurable g ∧ (∀ x, covectorEuclideanNorm (g x) ≤ 1) ∧ ∀ᵐ x ∂μ, 1 - η ≤ ξ x (g x)
